items.input: Avant-garde jazz influenced hip hop rap song about leprechauns

music.generatedLyrics:
[Intro]

[Verse]
Green velvet on the dash
Counting up the clover stash
Hidden in the briar patch
Don't try to make a match
Buckles on the leather shoes
Singing all the forest blues
I got nothing left to lose
Pick the gold that you choose

[Hook]
Seven folds in the rainbow
Watch the heavy brass flow
Where did all the silver go?
Deep inside the low glow

[Verse]
Saxophone in the morning mist
Gold coins in my fist
Never on the guest list
Give the pot a twist
Short stature, long reach
Lessons that I gotta teach
Walking on the pebble beach
Life is just a peach

[Pre-Chorus]
Shadows dancing on the pine
Everything is looking fine
Cross the jagged border line
Wait until the stars align

[Chorus]
Catch me if you can
I’m the lucky little man
Got a master emerald plan
Bigger than a caravan
Spinning on a single dime
Living in a different time
Climbing up the mountain climb
Hidden in a perfect rhyme

[Drop]
Green gold, green gold
Stories that were never told
Green gold, green gold
Breaking out the heavy mold

[Bridge]
Crystalline visions in the dark
Waiting for the sudden spark
Leave a little muddy mark
Singing like a meadow lark
Abstract notes upon the scale
Chasing down the golden trail
Wind inside the tattered sail
Never let the magic fail

[Verse]
Three wishes in the air
Do you even really care?
Life is never really fair
Spot the red and curly hair
Vanished in a puff of smoke
Was it all a cosmic joke?
Broken is the heavy yoke
Listen to the words I spoke

[Chorus]
Catch me if you can
I’m the lucky little man
Got a master emerald plan
Bigger than a caravan
Spinning on a single dime
Living in a different time
Climbing up the mountain climb
Hidden in a perfect rhyme

[Outro]
